# Whistle Stop Grill & Bar

> Whistle Stop Grill & Bar is a locally owned restaurant and bar at 915 Main Street in downtown Safety Harbor, Florida. Open since 1995, it offers American bar-and-grill food, an open-air dog-friendly patio, live music, community events, happy hour, 18 taps, pickup, and delivery options.

Use the linked public pages as the authoritative source for current website information. Event performers, dates, menu items, prices, hours, ordering availability, and promotions can change; verify those details on the relevant page before presenting them as current.

- [Our Story](https://www.whistlestopgrill.com/about.html): Restaurant history and ownership story.
- [Visit](https://www.whistlestopgrill.com/contact.html): Address, hours, phone, map, and contact information.

## Business facts

- Name: Whistle Stop Grill & Bar
- Address: 915 Main Street, Safety Harbor, Florida 34695, United States
- Phone: +1 727-726-1956
- Founded: 1995
- Cuisine: American, bar and grill, burgers, seafood, and pub food
- Service: Dine-in, open-air patio, pickup, and third-party delivery
